name: Hunter: Space Pirates
source:
At the tender age of three, our protagonist is separated from his mother under mysterious circumstances. A compassionate couple of neighbors, mourning the loss of their own son, adopt him. His foster father, a former Navy combat pilot known as "Viper," nurtures his passion for airplanes. However, tragedy strikes when the couple is killed by a hungry Grizzly bear. Now, on the cusp of adolescence, the boy is sent to a foster home where he must navigate life surrounded by four women. His journey to discover his true self is accompanied by a series of encounters with the girls at his foster home, each interaction shaping his understanding of relationships and desire.

[From [url=https://mistermistergames2020.itch.io/hunter-space-pirates]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三岁时，我们的主人公在神秘的情况下与母亲失散。一对富有同情心的邻居夫妇因失去自己的儿子而哀悼，收养了他。他的养父是一位前海军战斗飞行员，绰号“毒蛇”，培养了他对飞机的热情。然而，悲剧发生了，这对夫妇被一只饥饿的灰熊杀死。现在，正值青春期的男孩被送往寄养家庭，在那里他必须在四个女人的包围下度过生活。他发现真实自我的旅程伴随着与寄养家庭女孩的一系列相遇，每一次互动都塑造了他对人际关系和欲望的理解。

[来自[url=https://mistermistergames2020.itch.io/hunter-space-pirates]Itch.io[/url]]
